title: Fabio Egypt | From Bikini Bottom to the Red Sea
description: From SpongeBob videos to the wonders of Sharm El Sheikh. Discover the Red Sea with Fabio, from coral reefs and White Island to the Sinai Desert.
navTag: From Bikini Bottom to the Red Sea
heroBadge: Noticed the guy in the straw hat in our SpongeBob videos?
heroTitle: It's not just a cartoon. Discover your Bikini Bottom in the Red Sea!
heroSub: If you've come from our SpongeBob videos, the adventure continues here. I'm Fabio, I live in Sharm El Sheikh, and I'll help you discover the Red Sea: living coral, turquoise water and nights in the Sinai Desert.
fabioQuote: In Sharm El Sheikh, even Plankton would forget the secret formula! Come and discover the world you love imagining, between sea and desert, with Fabio.
sliderHint: Drag the portal and change Fabio's pose.
sliderLabel: Compare Bikini Bottom and the Red Sea
realImageAlt: The sea and coastline of Ras Mohammed in Sharm El Sheikh
sec2Sub: SpongeBob, Squidward, Patrick, Mr. Krabs, Plankton, Mrs. Puff and Sandy: six ways to imagine a holiday between sea and desert.
card1Desc: Ever wondered what swimming through Jellyfish Fields would feel like? Let Ras Mohammed's coral reef and colourful fish surprise you.
card2Desc: When Squidward dreams of a day away from the noise, we think of Sharm's White Island: pale sand surrounded by the turquoise waters of the Red Sea.
card3Desc: Beyond Sharm's sea lies the Sinai Desert. Sunsets, landscapes of sand and mountains, and the magic of an evening under the stars: an adventure to share with Patrick.
card4Title: Why Is Plankton Happy with Mr. Krabs?
card4Desc: In Bikini Bottom they're always arguing. Imagine them in Sharm: even they might discover that the real treasure is a day in the Red Sea with Fabio!
card5Desc: Mrs. Puff likes knowing what to expect! Ask Fabio about the itinerary, activities and details of your experience before you travel.
card6Desc: Like Sandy, do you love exploring and discovering something new? Bring your curiosity to the Red Sea and choose the experiences that suit you with Fabio, between sea and desert.
promoDesc: The formula? A little curiosity and a desire to travel. Copy the passphrase and send it to Fabio on WhatsApp to talk about experiences in Sharm El Sheikh.
perk1Desc: Sea, coral reef and desert: where would you like to start?
perk2Desc: Talk directly with Fabio about your next adventure.
perk3Desc: Bring our community's curiosity along with you.
copyError: Couldn't copy: select the passphrase and copy it yourself.
waGuarantee: Opens WhatsApp. You can read and edit the message before sending it.
waDefaultMsg: Hi Fabio! I've come from the SpongeBob videos. I have the passphrase SEGRETO-BIKINI and would love to discover experiences in Sharm El Sheikh!
selectionStatus: Selected experience: {experience}. Your message is ready in the bottle.
footerNote: From the imagination of Bikini Bottom to the wonders of the Red Sea.
relatedIntro: Real places, experiences to enjoy. Ask Fabio to help you choose yours.
plannerDescription: More than a single excursion: tell us how you imagine your holiday and plan a complete tailor-made itinerary with Fabio.
plannerHint: A complete itinerary, shaped around you
